from scipy.optimize import least_squares
forms={
"A a(K-P)^n":(lambda p,x: p[0]*np.abs(p[1]-x)**p[2], [15,6,1]),
"B a(K-P)exp(-bP)":(lambda p,x: p[0]*(p[1]-x)*np.exp(-p[2]*x), [3,6,0.1]),
"C a exp(-bP)-cP+d":(lambda p,x: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*x)-p[2]*x+p[3], [10,0.1,1,1]),
"D a(1-P/K)^n + c P":(lambda p,x: p[0]*(1-x/p[1])**p[2]+p[3]*x, [15,6,1,0]),
"E a/(1+bP)+cP+d":(lambda p,x: p[0]/(1+p[1]*x)+p[2]*x+p[3], [10,0.2,-1,1]),
"F a P^p(K-P)+c": (lambda p,x: p[0]*np.abs(x)**p[1]*(p[2]-x)+p[3],[1,0.5,6,1]),
"G a(K-P)+b P ln(K/P)": (lambda p,x: p[0]*(p[1]-x)+p[2]*x*np.log(p[1]/x),[3,6,1]),
}
for name,(fn,p0) in forms.items():

def rat(nn,dd):
    # linearized: y*(1+sum d_j P^j) = sum n_i P^i
    y=dP_dt
    M=np.column_stack([P**i for i in range(nn+1)]+[-y*P**j for j in range(1,dd+1)])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(M,y,rcond=None)[0]
    n=c[:nn+1]; d=np.concatenate([[1],c[nn+1:]])
    pred=np.polyval(n[::-1],P)/np.polyval(d[::-1],P)
    return np.std(dP_dt-pred)/np.std(dP_dt), n, d
for nn,dd in [(3,1),(3,2),(2,1),(2,2),(3,3),(4,1)]:
    e,n,d=rat(nn,dd); print(nn,dd,e, np.round(n,5), np.round(d,6))
